import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Module
import Mathlib.Data.Finset
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Infinite

open Module

theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3}
  [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Finite ι] [Infinite K]
  (f : ι → Module.Dual K M)
  (h : ∀ (i : ι), ∃ x, (f i) x ≠ 0) : ∃ x, ∀ (i : ι), (f i) x ≠ 0 := by
  let n := Fin.card ι
  let idx : ι → Fin n := Fin.choose _ 
  let v : Fin n → M := by {
    refine ⟨_, _⟩
    intro i
    have h_i : ∃ x, (f (idx⁻¹ i)) x ≠ 0 := h (idx⁻¹ i)
    choose x_i h_x_i using h_i
    exact x_i
  }
  let x : M := 0
  let mut s : Set M := ∅
  let mut i : ℕ := 0
  while i < n do
    let j := Fin.cast i
    let m := v j
    let hm : (f (idx j)) m ≠ 0 := by {
      rw ← h_x_i at h_x_i
      exact h_x_i
    }
    let s' := s ∪ {m}
    set s := s'
    set i := i + 1
  let x := s.nonempty.choose
  exact ⟨x, fun i => by {
    rcases Fin.choose_eq_idx.1 (Fin.choose_injective _) i with ⟨j, hj⟩
    have h_ne_zero : (f (idx j)) x ≠ 0 :=
      by {
        rw ← h_x_i at h_x_i
        exact h_x_i
      }
    exact h_ne_zero
  }>
